units.rawText: These are my favorite guns. One is called Destiny, the other Salvation.

units.rawText: Listen, this is the sound they make as they chamber rounds.

units.rawText: You didn't think they were simple decorations, did you? I'd like you to hear them firing, if the chance comes up—it's even more marvelous than the sound of them chambering bullets.
